request.text: I need the iPhone 15 generation in the Mini size, new. Can you find an iPhone 15 mini for delivery to Beirut?

message:
Apple never made an iPhone 15 mini. The last Mini was the 5.4-inch iPhone 13 mini; the smallest iPhone 15 models are 6.1 inches.
Closest checked alternatives:
• iStore Plus: iPhone 15 Pro 128GB — $1080.00, listed in stock. Lebanon-wide delivery is advertised, but the fee and brand-new condition are unconfirmed.
• Phonefinity: standard iPhone 15 128GB Blue — $830.00, currently out of stock. Beirut delivery is $3; new condition is unconfirmed.
• Mobileleb: iPhone 13 mini 128GB — $320.00, listed in stock, but explicitly Open Box, so excluded from your new-only requirement. Delivery terms were not confirmed.
Suggestion: keep your new-only requirement and consider the larger standard iPhone 15; none of these checked listings confirms a new Mini that meets your request.
